display.purpose: The group's name on the sign, and only there. clamp(44px, 13vw, 96px) with line-height 0.9 below 1024px.

headline.purpose: Day headings and the headline of a plain message page. 40px below 1024px.

title.purpose: The author of a post, in primary 700. 28px below 1024px.

title-small.purpose: The author of a comment, in primary 700. The member's own name on the sign is the same serif at 18px/24px, weight 640.

body.purpose: Post and comment text, fields, and buttons. Reading column at most 608px.

label.purpose: Small text on the sign, times (tabular figures), the comments summary, the new mark, loading and end lines.

motion.name: fade-in
motion.purpose: Comments arriving in an opened thread. Only under motion-safe; nothing else moves.

focus.purpose: Keyboard focus everywhere; on the orange sign the outline is stone 900.

components.name: The Sign
components.description: Full-width orange band at the top of a group page carrying the group's name.
components.css: .ds-sign { background: oklch(70.5% 0.213 47.604); color: oklch(21.6% 0.006 56.043); padding: 18px 72px 30px; min-height: 152px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; justify-content: space-between; gap: 8px; box-sizing: border-box; } .ds-sign-top { display: flex; align-items: baseline; gap: 20px; font-family: "Source Sans 3", ui-sans-serif, system-ui, sans-serif; font-weight: 400; font-size: 15px; line-height: 24px; } .ds-sign-person { margin-left: auto; font-family: Fraunces, ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-variation-settings: "SOFT" 100, "WONK" 0; font-weight: 640; font-size: 18px; } .ds-sign-name { margin: 0; font-family: Fraunces, ui-serif, Georgia, serif; font-variation-settings: "SOFT" 100, "WONK" 0; font-weight: 620; font-size: 96px; line-height: 0.8; letter-spacing: -0.02em; }

narrative.overview:
A group's page is a painted neighbourhood shop sign over a plain white shop floor. The sign is a full-width band of orange carrying the group's name in a soft, heavy serif. Below it, people talk: every author's name is set in that same serif, large and in orange, so the page reads as named people speaking rather than as a feed of items. Everything else is one quiet sans at one weight, on white, with as little interface as the task allows.

The system has two display moves and only two: **the sign** and **the names** (with the day headings, which share the names' serif and sit between them as the largest type below the sign). Everything that is not a person, a day, or the group is interface, and interface stays small, grey, and out of the way. There are no cards, panels, boxes, or shadows; structure comes from type size, a shared left edge, and white space. Nothing moves on its own.

The page is self-contained: both fonts, the stylesheet, the scripts, and the icon are served by the app itself, and no page makes a request to any third party.
keyCharacteristics: A full-width orange sign at the top of every group page, carrying the group's name at up to 96px in near-black.
Names, day headings, and the group's name in Fraunces (softness at full, leaning letters off, set heavy); everything else in Source Sans 3 Regular.
Author names in orange 700, hung in a 200px left margin column on wide screens.
White page, near-black text, stone greys for secondary text and lines. No cards, boxes, or shadows.
Pill-shaped field and buttons; one orange button per page.
Orange 500 appears below the sign only on the primary action and the "new" dot.

rules.name: The One Meaning Rule
rules.body: Orange stands for the group, a person, or something new from one. Below the sign, Shop-Sign Orange fills exactly two things: the primary action and the "new" dot. The only other orange is Lettering Orange, for names, the "new" word, and keyboard focus.

rules.name: The Orange 700 Text Rule
rules.body: Orange text is primary 700 or darker, always. Primary 500 is for fills and marks only.

rules.name: The Name-It-Primary Rule
rules.body: Pages name the accent as `primary`, never by its hue, so a configured accent changes every page at once.

rules.name: The Not-Only-Colour Rule
rules.body: State is carried in form as well as colour: "new" is a dot and a word; a refusal is an icon and a sentence; a disabled button is dimmed and loses its pointer.

rules.name: The Names Are Display Rule
rules.body: Every person's name is set in Fraunces in Lettering Orange, wherever it appears in the timeline. A name is never body text, and never accompanied by an avatar.

rules.name: The One Weight Rule
rules.body: The sans has one weight, 400. Emphasis comes from the serif, from size, or from colour, never from bold sans. Only the regular weight is shipped.

rules.name: The Heavier When Smaller Rule
rules.body: Fraunces gets slightly heavier as it gets smaller (620 at 64-96px, 640 at 18-36px, 680 at 20px for comment names), so the names keep their painted weight at every size.

rules.name: The One Left Edge Rule
rules.body: The group's name, the day headings, and the margin names start on the same vertical line. A new surface that has a sign keeps it.

rules.name: The Reserved Margin Rule
rules.body: The right side of a wide screen belongs to upcoming events. Leave it empty until they ship.

rules.name: The Flat Shop Floor Rule
rules.body: Nothing on the page casts a shadow or sits in a box. A post is a name and its text, never a card.

dos: Do name the accent as `primary-*`, never `orange-*`.
Do set every person's name in Fraunces in primary 700, at Title size for authors of posts and Title small inside threads.
Do keep primary 500 to the sign, the one primary action on a surface, and the "new" dot.
Do put orange text in primary 700 or darker.
Do carry state in form as well as colour: a dot and a word, an icon and a sentence.
Do keep the sign's lettering, headings, and margin names on one left edge, and keep the reading column at most 608px.
Do use pills for every button and field: one filled primary, everything else outlined in stone 500.
Do serve every font, script, stylesheet, and image from the app itself.
Do keep openings to a short fade (180ms), wrapped in `motion-safe`, and let nothing move on its own.
Do leave the right side of a wide screen empty until upcoming events fill it.
donts: Don't put posts, comments, or anything else in cards, panels, boxes, or shadows.
Don't add a second filled orange button to a surface, or use primary 500 for text on white.
Don't add avatars, counters beside names, badges, or a grey feed background.
Don't use bold or uppercase letter-spaced sans for emphasis or labels; the sans has one weight.
Don't introduce a colour outside Tailwind's default orange (as `primary`) and stone scales, including red for errors.
Don't load anything from a third party: no font host, no CDN, no analytics, no embedded widget.
Don't show a control for something that is not built yet.
Don't make the sign sticky; it scrolls away with the page.
